objectives.title: Read the admin's flag
objectives.prompt: Get the server to treat you as the admin and read the flag it keeps for the admin.
hints: Read how the session key is derived from both sides' keys.
Which private key would let you impersonate whom? The flag's name is a strong hint.

steps.title: Identify the key exchange
steps.prompt: Which key exchange do the certificates' keys use? (acronym)

steps.title: Know your identity
steps.prompt: Which certificate are you given as a player?

steps.title: Name the attack
steps.prompt: What is the attack called where knowing one party's private key lets you impersonate others to that party?
